title: Blow-up integrals over a finite-measure set of zero n-density at x tend to 0 (Simon 3.1.6 ⇒, error estimate)
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, x ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ} (= Amb n ℓ), Hⁿ := μHE[n], and let A ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} be a set with Hⁿ(A) < ∞ (no measurability assumed). Suppose that A has n-density zero at x in the sense (ρⁿ)⁻¹·Hⁿ.real(A ∩ B_ρ(x)) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0, where B_ρ(x) is the closed ball and Hⁿ.real := (Hⁿ ·).toReal. Then for every compactly supported continuous f : ℝ^{n+ℓ} → ℝ (f ∈ C_c(ℝ^{n+ℓ}, ℝ)), ∫_{η_{x,r}(A)} f dHⁿ → 0 as r ↓ 0, where η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x) is Simon's blow-up map (Chapter03.blowUpMap x r).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (x : Amb n ℓ) (A : Set (Amb n ℓ)), (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) A < ∞ → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (ρ ^ n)⁻¹ * (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).real (A ∩ closedBall x ρ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Amb n ℓ) ℝ, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' A, f y ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
